nodes.description: During or after adequate chemotherapy, existing nodes enlarge or new nodes, abscesses or sinuses appear without drug resistance or relapse. nodes.description: Isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol for two months, then isoniazid and rifampicin for four months, is the standard treatment. In trials, six months performed as well as nine months (British Thoracic Society trial; a Hong Kong thrice-weekly trial) and cured most children with extensive disease. Nodes respond more slowly than pulmonary disease, and in one small series with ultrasound follow-up only 63% had no residual node over 1 cm at six months, so some clinicians extend treatment; bilateral cervical nodes and low body mass index predicted a prolonged course.
